front: Give the size ranges of **acute**, **obtuse** and **reflex** angles.
back: Acute: between $0^\circ$ and $90^\circ$. Obtuse: between $90^\circ$ and $180^\circ$. Reflex: between $180^\circ$ and $360^\circ$.
notes: A right angle is exactly $90^\circ$ and a straight angle exactly $180^\circ$.

back: Two angles that add up to $90^\circ$.
Two angles that add up to $180^\circ$.

front: What do $AB \parallel CD$ and $AB \perp CD$ mean?
back: $AB \parallel CD$: $AB$ is parallel to $CD$ (they never meet). $AB \perp CD$: $AB$ is perpendicular to $CD$ (they meet at $90^\circ$).

front: What is the difference between a **chord** and a **tangent**?
back: A chord joins two points on a circle. A tangent is a straight line that touches the circle at exactly one point.

front: What is the difference between a **sector** and a **segment**?
back: A sector is bounded by two radii and an arc. A segment is bounded by a chord and an arc.

front: Name the polygons with 7, 8, 9 and 10 sides.

back: A solid with the same cross-section all the way through: two identical end faces joined by rectangles.
notes: A cuboid is a prism with a rectangular cross-section.

front: What is a **net** of a solid?
back: A flat shape that folds up to make the solid.
notes: A cube has a net of six squares.

front: What is the difference between **congruent** and **similar** shapes?
back: Congruent: same shape **and** same size. Similar: same shape, with every length multiplied by the same scale factor.
